questions.question: While Peter and John were speaking to the people, the priests and Sadducees became greatly disturbed. Why?

answers.text: They taught about the resurrection in Jesus
They broke the Sabbath in the temple

questions.question: When the council questioned Peter and John about healing a lame man, by whose name did Peter say he was healed?
The council could not deny the miracle but wanted to stop the message spreading. What did they decide to do about Peter and John?

answers.text: Warn them not to speak in Jesus' name
Run them out of Jerusalem for good
Hand them over to Pilate for trial

questions.question: When the believers prayed about the council's threats against Peter and John, what did they ask God to give them?
